subtitles.en: 2 Samuel 6: the ark of the Elohim brought up to the city of David, and the breach of Uzzah

descriptions.en:
An English translation of **2 Samuel 6**, the chapter the Raëlian canon cites: David brings up the ark of the Elohim, 'enthroned on the cherubim', from Ba'alei-Yehudah; Uzzah touches the ark and dies beside it; David dances before YHWH as the ark enters the city of David. The rest of the book is not translated.

Source: Sefaria v3 API, Tanach with Ta'amei Hamikra (Westminster Leningrad Codex base, Public Domain); Ketiv/Qere sites translate the Qere and are noted. Reference translation: ASV (1901). Proper names are transliterated from the Hebrew, as in the Kings volumes, with the English form in the chapter title.
